title: HYGIEIA: Multi Disease Diagnosis Framework
summary: A Framework has been built with multiple models to predict variety of conditions with scalable features and high trustworthy accuracy.
description: This Framework uses multiple AI models to diagnose. It has AI Chatting capabilities for the Healthcare and Blockchain integration. It integrates data from different sources to provide reliable health assessments.

hero.title: Your health,
hero.lede: Hygieia bundles five independently trained diagnostic models behind one calm interface, writes every result to a tamper-evident chain, and answers questions through Dr. Hygieia, an assistant that reads your own history.

paragraphs: Hygieia bundles five independently trained diagnostic models behind one interface, so a clinician or a curious patient can move between a heart-risk questionnaire and a dermatology image scan without changing tools.

Every prediction is written to an append-only chain with a SHA-256 hash, which means a result can be re-verified later and any tampering shows up as a broken chain. On top of that sits Dr. Hygieia, a context-aware assistant that can read your own analysis history when it answers.

title: Scholar Track: PhD Scholar Tracking Portal
summary: A portal that carries a PhD scholar from admission to degree through four Doctoral Committee reviews, with two-step approvals, document uploads, an audit trail and templated email. GitHub-inspired interface in light and dark.
description: Scholar Track replaces paper files and email threads with one source of truth for a research office: three roles (scholar, supervisor, R&D section), five gated milestones, presigned uploads to object storage with authenticated proxies, hashed portal keys and reset tokens, and a full audit log. Built with Next.js 14, Prisma on Neon Postgres, NextAuth, Tailwind and Brevo.

hero.title: The PhD journey,
hero.lede: Scholar Track guides a research scholar through four Doctoral Committee reviews and a degree stage, with a two-step approval at every milestone. One portal, three roles, a full audit trail, and an interface that reads like a well-set journal.

paragraphs: The portal replaces paper files and email threads with a single source of truth. Every transition is enforced on the server, every rejection carries remarks, and every step writes an audit row.
Scholars always know what to do next; supervisors and the R&D section always know what is waiting for them, with live counters in the navigation.

features.title: Scholar
features.description: Registers with a one-time portal key, files the proposal, uploads milestone documents and always sees the next step.

features.title: Supervisor
features.description: Constitutes the Doctoral Committee, assigns a co-supervisor and approves or returns each application with remarks.

features.title: R&D Section
features.description: Issues portal keys, allocates supervisors, gives the final approval, records meetings and issues the degree.

features.title: Notified at every step
features.description: Templated HTML email for onboarding, reviews, allocations, meetings, degrees and password flows.

features.title: Files never public
features.description: Presigned uploads straight to object storage, then authenticated proxies stream every document.

features.title: GitHub-inspired UI
features.description: Hairline borders, one accent, semantic state labels and serif headings, in light and dark.

items.title: The scholar uploads and submits
items.body: Each stage lists exactly which documents are required. Uploads go straight to object storage through short-lived signed URLs, with progress, and the application cannot be submitted until every slot is filled.
ticks: Required-document checklist
Direct-to-bucket uploads, 10MB, PDF/JPG/PNG
Application tracker with dates and remarks

image.alt: DC2 application with four uploaded documents

items.title: The supervisor reviews
items.body: The scholar page puts the proposal, committee, documents and the decision form on one screen. Returning an application requires remarks, which land in the scholar's tracker and inbox.
ticks: Committee picker, 2 to 5 members from the pool
Approve, or return with mandatory remarks
Email to the scholar and the R&D queue

items.title: The R&D section closes the loop
items.body: Queues with live counters show what is waiting: supervisor requests, final approvals, and meetings to record. Marking a meeting complete unlocks the next stage; on the last stage it issues the degree.
ticks: Counters in the navigation
One click to record a meeting or issue a degree

items.title: And the journey ends with a degree
items.body: The scholar's overview turns fully green, the completion record shows the issue date, and the final email congratulates the new doctor.

title: CTR - Indian National Car Racing Championship
summary: The official portal of the CTR-JK Tyre FMSCI Indian National Car Racing Championship: newsroom, schedule with live round countdown, results, standings, drivers, teams, tickets and hospitality, videos, polls and a fan zone with accounts.
description: https://www.ctrsports.in. The championship-first home of the 2026 INCRC - One Nation, One Championship. Built with Next.js and TailwindCSS as an editorial product rather than a brochure: a magazine-style Latest page with venue guides and category explainers, a ticker that always shows the current round and session, drivers' and teams' standings, four ticket and hospitality tiers, and a Fan Zone with sign-in, predictions, polls, favourites and a newsletter, across Kari Motor Speedway, Bren Raceway and the Madras International Circuit.

title: Predicting Microsoft Stock Values
summary: This project uses time series analysis and Keras to predict Microsoft stock values. The model was trained and evaluated, showing a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 16.94 (5.75% error) on data from 2020-2025.
description: A comprehensive stock prediction system using deep learning techniques including LSTM networks for time series forecasting. The project handles data preprocessing, time filtering, and timezone considerations.
